title: prod-blue node pool upgrade stuck at 1 of 6 nodes
scenario: The 1.34 surge upgrade of prod-blue's default node pool started in the maintenance window, upgraded one node and has been draining the second for almost an hour. GKE stops honouring PDBs after a bounded wait, so RIQ is about to lose a replica the hard way. You get the page, the GKE operation and logs, kubectl output, the rendered manifests ArgoCD syncs and a drain simulator.
task: Reproduce the stuck drain with make drain and find the PDB that allows zero disruptions
Explain why it allows zero although all four stable pods are Ready; rule out the quota theory
Fix the manifests in k8s/ (not the RIQ team's canary chart) so drains proceed and the budget still protects RIQ
Root cause, evidence, immediate mitigation and prevention in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Every node drains with the canary crash-looping, healthy or absent
The riq-api budget covers exactly the four stable pods and still stops a drain when two are down
Stable Deployment and mdm budgets unchanged
Root cause with evidence from the PDB status, pods and events in ANSWER.md

practices.label: Week 2 - Thu: PDBs, readiness, preStop, safely drain a node
Week 2 - Wed: surge vs blue-green and upgrade quota
